entities.summary: Henri-Godefroi-Bernard-Alphonse, 1st Prince de La Tour d'Auvergne, 2nd Marquis de Saint-Paulet was a French politician of the Second Empire who twice served as Minister of Foreign Affairs for Emperor Napoleon III.
